STYLE GUIDE (apply to every asset):
Top-down 3/4 perspective pixel art for a 2D mystery/investigation game, in the readable, cozy-clean style of classic farming/life-sim pixel games, but dark and atmospheric.
Setting: an original foggy Victorian-era industrial world with occult undertones: cobblestone streets, gas lamps, soot-stained brick, wrought iron, canals, chapels, secret societies, alchemical potions.
Grid: strict 16x16 pixel tiles. Every pixel must align to the grid; no half pixels, no sub-pixel detail.
Pixels: crisp hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients; deliberate 2-tone checker dithering only on large surfaces or for fake transparency. 1px dark outline in deep blue-grey (around #1a1c2c, not pure black) on props; terrain tiles have no outline.
Palette: limited muted palette of max 32 colors. Desaturated slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, mossy greens, rust and brass, bone white; warm amber/yellow only for gas lamp light and candles; turquoise #6fe0d0 reserved for occult props and never tilesets. Avoid saturated primaries and pure black/white.
Lighting: flat base colors with 2-3 shade steps; light from top-left. Do not bake night darkness into sprites.
Mood: melancholic, mysterious, slightly unsettling, never gory.
Output: transparent background PNG alpha unless stated otherwise, orthographic, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
Avoid: 3D render look, painterly style, photorealism, chibi exaggeration, anime eyes, references to existing games, films or franchises.
Precisely 256x256 logical pixels, drawn at 4x nearest neighbour scale if necessary. Exactly 16 columns and 16 rows of 16x16 tiles, no gaps or grid lines. Fill ONLY first 4 rows, remaining 12 rows fully transparent. Row 0: 8 seamless floor variants, then 8 low-lying mud/puddle floor variants. Row 1: 16 water shore tiles indexed by NESW bit mask 0..15, dark flat slate water interior with land at edges where bit absent (N=1 E=2 S=4 W=8). Row 2: wall with waterline, wall waterline corner, descending stairs, ascending stairs, horizontal bridge, vertical bridge, dock edge north, east, south, west, six facade wall tiles (plain, window, door, corner, window pair, arch). Row 3: four roof tiles, three railing tiles, quay cap, eight theme-specific architectural tiles. All structural pieces must fit their cell, no merged illustration.
Tileset for Victorian tidal harbour Varrowmouth at LOW TIDE. Theme hafen: basalt quay, customs-house saltwashed paving, mooring bollards, iron crane base, tide tower footings. Dark saline grey green, tar, bleached timber and rust. No turquoise. Exposed lower stairs and quay mud.

Setting: an original foggy Victorian-era industrial world with occult undertones: cobblestone streets, gas lamps, soot-stained brick, wrought iron, canals, chapels, secret societies, alchemical potions.
Grid: strict 16x16 pixel tiles. Every pixel must align to the grid; no half pixels, no sub-pixel detail.
Pixels: crisp hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients; deliberate 2-tone checker dithering only on large surfaces or for fake transparency. 1px dark outline in deep blue-grey (around #1a1c2c, not pure black) on props; terrain tiles have no outline.
Palette: limited muted palette of max 32 colors. Desaturated slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, mossy greens, rust and brass, bone white; warm amber/yellow only for gas lamp light and candles; turquoise #6fe0d0 reserved for occult props and never tilesets. Avoid saturated primaries and pure black/white.
Lighting: flat base colors with 2-3 shade steps; light from top-left. Do not bake night darkness into sprites.
Mood: melancholic, mysterious, slightly unsettling, never gory.
Output: transparent background PNG alpha unless stated otherwise, orthographic, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
Avoid: 3D render look, painterly style, photorealism, chibi exaggeration, anime eyes, references to existing games, films or franchises.
Edit reference tileset to HIGH TIDE. Keep the same canvas and exact 16 column by 4 occupied row layout, all same architecture and positioning. Change ONLY water level: row 0 columns 8 through 15 now fully submerged flat dark slate water. Row 2 first four columns wall water line and steps submerged to halfway up tile. Row 2 dock edges columns 6..9 have higher water reaching under boards. Preserve all other pixels. No turquoise, no text. Empty area remains alpha transparent. Theme innen.
